findings_qualitative.value: IRX-beta_UV at z~6 is shallower than Calzetti, Meurer and SMC relations and matches Fudamoto et al. (2020a) z~5.5

evidence.quote: We find that our result from the stacking analysis supports a shallower IRX- β UV relation than the Calzetti (Calzetti et al. 2000) and Meurer (Meurer et al. 1999) relations.

findings_qualitative.value: T_dust results support linear (1+z) evolution rather than quadratic

evidence.quote: Our results support the linear relation of ∝ (1+ z ) 1 (Schreiber et al. 2018) rather than the quadratic relation ∝ (1+ z ) 2 (Viero et al. 2022).

claims.hypothesis: Is the IRX-beta_UV relation at z~6 shallower than at z~2-4?
claims.experiment: Stacked Band 6 and 8 continuum in two beta_UV bins with MBB fits
claims.result: Shallower than Calzetti/Meurer/SMC, ~1 dex lower than z~3 at beta_UV~0
claims.finding: Shallow IRX-beta_UV at z~6, matching z~5.5 single-band results

evidence.quote: The IRX- β UV relation derived from multi-band observations at z ~ 6 appears to be ~ 1 dex lower than that at z ~ 3 at β UV ~ 0.

claims.hypothesis: How much of the SFRD at z~6 is dust-obscured?
claims.experiment: Convert UV luminosity function using M_UV-beta_UV and IRX-beta_UV (and f_obs-M_UV) relations
claims.finding: Limited contribution (~30%) of dust-obscured SF in UV-selected galaxies

evidence.quote: Thus, we conclude that the contribution of the dust-obscured star formation activity from LBGs is not dominant

claims.hypothesis: Does T_dust increase gently with redshift to z~6-7?

evidence.quote: supports a gentle increase of T dust from z = 0 to z ~ 6–7.

claims.hypothesis: Can the T_dust evolution and scatter be physically explained?
claims.experiment: Analytic model of Sommovigo et al. (2022) with t_gas and metallicity evolution
claims.result: ~0.6 dex increase in gas depletion time scale and ~0.4 dex metallicity decrease reproduce the trend; main-sequence and mass-metallicity scatter give ±12 K
claims.finding: Evolution and scatter explained by t_gas, metallicity and scatter around relations

evidence.quote: the observed redshift evolution of the dust temperature can be reproduced by an ~ 0.6 dex increase in the gas depletion timescale and ~ 0.4 dex decrease of the metallicity.

why_this_method.value: Band 8 covers rest ~90 um near the dust peak at z~6, constraining T_dust

evidence.quote: The ALMA Band-8, covering rest-frame ~ 90 µm dust continuum near the peak of the dust thermal emission at z ~ 6, enables us to constrain T dust .
